intro: President Trump dismissed concerns about artificial intelligence safety, stating the US has adequate tools to manage risks, following warnings from Anthropic researchers about potential harms. Trump also criticized Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's calls for slower AI development, while xAI filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and Apple over ChatGPT's iPhone integration. Meanwhile, UK lawmakers are drafting new legislation to address AI threats to human rights, including risks from facial recognition and deepfakes.
